Refund Policy

1. General Refund Principles

We strive to ensure student satisfaction. This Refund Policy applies to all enrollment tiers for the GenAI and/or Core AI Skills Course. All refund requests must be submitted in writing to support@manishd.in.

2. Eligibility Period for Refund

Refunds will only be considered if requested within the first 14 days following your initial enrollment date.

3. Calculation of Refund

  • Full Refund: If you request a refund before the start date of the first live class, you will be eligible for a 100% refund of the tuition fee paid.
  • Partial Refund: If you request a refund after the first live class has commenced but still within the 14-day eligibility period, your refund will be the total tuition fee paid minus a $150 administrative fee (to cover initial setup and processing costs) and a pro-rated amount for any live classes or support sessions already conducted or recorded materials accessed.
  • No Refund: No refunds will be granted after the 14-day eligibility period, regardless of attendance or use of the materials.
  • Tier-Specific Exception: Due to the deeply discounted nature of the Student ($101) tier, no refunds will be issued for this tier once the first live class has been accessed or the 14-day eligibility period has passed.

4. Processing

Refunds, if approved, will be processed within 30 business days and returned to the original method of payment.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about our refund policy, please contact us at support@manishd.in.
